name: Bite
description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the monstrosity. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the monstrosity, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the monstrosity's turns.
If the monstrosity takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the monstrosity must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the monstrosity. If the monstrosity dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.
